title: Who do you feel “you are” when you are in TheMallWorld?
content: I feel sometimes I’m a student, once I felt they try to recruit me, sometimes lost with the feeling of “why I’m here?” and a customer. Yesterday I talked with someone who was playing in the Arcade, he was playing the game I wanted to play he saw my excited reaction and his response was “Yes, I know. Amazing.” the arcade wasn’t full. They had games I HAVE NEVER SEEN. But just amazing to play with. I’m currently collecting some SpongeBob cards from a Skee-Ball Machine. (I hope I can get them all). Their was an old man 👴 hovering around too. Idk about him. Wasn’t playing. Just looking. Didn’t felt any vibe from him, just that it was there looking at us play. Love to read everyone stories, good luck to all of us in our journey. 🍀
